phase_title: Production II: Act 2 (R3-R5) and Early Access
goal: Act 2 (R3-R5) is built to the Definition of Done, Early Access has launched (~2030-03-15) with a steady patch cadence, and Gate 4 health criteria are measured.
exit_criteria: 9 Act 2 bosses (R3-B01..R5-B03) with Hell phases and green replay tests
50 side, 10 secret (12 time-sensitive) quests and SS-04..07 completable by the bot
25 Tier B (NPC-B-26..50), 3 Tier A, 3 companions (CMP-04..06), ~70 Tier C
ITM-121..270, COM-031..070, AH-02, AH-03 and limited-edition calendar v1 live; economy sim stable
Companion synergies, market agents at scale, adaptive music at scale merged with tests
Early Access launched; EA-H01 and EA-P01..P06 shipped with save migration each
Gate 4 on 2030-09-30: review/retention targets read from real data, crash-free ≥ 99.5%, save migration 100%, exploit turnaround ≤ 1 patch

tasks.title: Build boss R4-B01
tasks.why: P2/P6 + ROADMAP §7 Y4: Act 2 boss in R4 Forgotten Sectors; every boss has a Hell-only phase (§3, §12.1)

days.focus: R4-B01: design doc and pattern sheet
steps: Run `/design-system` for `design/gdd/bosses/r4_b01.md` with all 8 sections: attack list, phase HP thresholds, poise, arena needs
Write each attack's readable cue (pose, sound, VFX) and its §12.1 telegraph scale: ×1.5 / ×1.25 / ×1.0 / ×0.85 / ×0.7
Sketch the R4-B01 Hell-only phase and the +variants that switch on at Medium and Hard

days.done: `design/gdd/bosses/r4_b01.md` passes /design-review; the attack and phase table is frozen

steps: Author one AttackSpec `.tres` per attack under `resources/combat/bosses/r4_b01/` (startup / active / recovery frames)
Assign hitstop tiers and punish windows; parry windows stay owned by DifficultyProfile, never by stats (§12.8)
Fill BossDef and PhaseDef for R4-B01: poise per phase, thresholds, stagger rules
Unit test `tests/unit/bosses/test_r4_b01_frame_data.gd`: every AttackSpec points at real animation frames
days.done: R4-B01 frame data loads and test_r4_b01_frame_data passes

days.focus: R4-B01: phase 1 AI on the fixed tick
steps: Implement phase 1 states in `scripts/combat/bosses/r4_b01_ai.gd` on the fixed tick, with no `create_timer` or `await` timers
Pick patterns by weighted choice from the seeded RNG so input replays stay deterministic
Emit telegraph-start events to FeelService and the audio cue bus
Add a debug overlay for R4-B01: state, next attack, poise
days.done: R4-B01 phase 1 runs end to end in its arena test scene

steps: Add R4-B01 phase 2 states and the transition (invulnerable window, arena change if the doc asks)
Gate the Medium/Hard +variant attacks on the active DifficultyProfile
Assert stat invariants across the transition: HP, poise and buffs never reset
Pause and unpause through ContextStack mid-transition; nothing is skipped
days.done: R4-B01 phases 1-2 and variants run on all 5 profiles with no stuck state

steps: Declare R4-B01's arena needs for arena generation: Forgotten Sectors biome, terrain shape, hazards, camera bounds
Add hazard nodes on the named physics layers plus the arena kill zone
Verify the return to the same world position after victory, defeat and retry (P1)
Profile arena build time against the under-1-second shatter-transition budget
days.done: R4-B01 arena builds from terrain context and returns the player to the same tile

steps: Implement the R4-B01 Hell-only phase: telegraph ×0.7, 2-frame parry windows (33 ms)
Confirm the 4-frame input buffer and the latency calibration offset apply in this phase
Record a perfect-input replay of the Hell phase as `tests/fixtures/replays/r4_b01_hell.replay`
Check loot: Hell adds cosmetics/titles only; nothing essential is Hell-exclusive
days.done: The R4-B01 Hell phase is beaten by the reference replay

days.focus: R4-B01: difficulty data, rewards, flags and world hook-up
steps: Wire enemy damage ×0.6 / ×0.8 / ×1.0 / ×1.3 / ×2.0, healing charges 5/4/3/2/1 and DDA through DifficultyProfile
Grant R4-B01 rewards via RewardLedger `grant_once` and write the defeat/choice flags assigned to it in the Y2 route table
Place the R4-B01 trigger in its Forgotten Sectors chunk; connect CIN-R4-B01-IN / CIN-R4-B01-OUT
Reload from the pre-fight checkpoint: no double grant; boss context clears on load
days.done: R4-B01 rewards grant once and the fight runs from world trigger to outro

steps: Write `tests/integration/bosses/test_r4_b01_replay.gd`: the Hell replay wins; the same replay shifted one frame on a parry loses
Add the 5-retry invariant test and a pause-during-transition test
Run `/smoke-check`; capture one screenshot per phase
Save screenshots and the replay log to `production/qa/evidence/y4/R4-B01/`
days.done: R4-B01 replay and invariant tests are green in CI
